description: See real AI tools recently added to GateOnAI - based on genuine addition timestamps, not a guess or a static list. Optionally filter by category. Useful for staying current on new tool launches or checking what's new in a specific space (e.g. new AI Agents tools this week).

category.description: Optional category slug to filter by, e.g. 'ai-agents', 'marketing', 'design'. Omit to see all categories.

days.description: How many days back to look (1-30, default 7)

name: whats_new

is_error.description: True if the tool could not complete the request

links.description: gateonai.com URLs referenced in the result, in order of appearance

markdown.description: The full result as Markdown (same as the text content), including GateOnAI's disclaimer

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this result

title: What's New on GateOnAI
